div.h1: PR #6 - game over and restart: two states, one owner
div.p: Game owns score, lives and state and exposes them read-only. The bootstrap copies the state into the views every frame; the views never call back into Game.

g.text: Game: the only writer of score, lives and state

text.tspan: despawn from the end: no swapping
sprites leave the world, objects go back to the pool

g.text: Views: written to by the bootstrap, never read by Game

text.tspan: RULE: the rules own the numbers and the state.
Input is a typed set of actions, views are written to once per change,
and a restart returns the game to the same start state every time.
visible flag: the DOM is touched
h1, final score, Press Space to play again
